work.title: The Twilight of the Idols
work.notes: Written in 1888 and published in 1889. This manifest represents only The Twilight of the Idols even though the supplied EPUB is a historical volume that also contains The Antichrist.

passages.citationLabel: The Twilight of the Idols, “Maxims and Missiles” §8, Ludovici trans.
passages.translationText: From the military school of life. —That which does not kill me, makes me stronger.
passages.interpretiveNote: This is a compressed aphoristic provocation about overcoming resistance, not a universal empirical promise that every injury, trauma, or deprivation necessarily produces strength.
